content.text: Animals is a hilarious and chaotic reaction game derived from the classic Snap. While standard Snap requires players to shout 'Snap!' when ranks match, Animals requires each player to pick a specific animal and make that animal's sound (or shout its name) when a match occurs. It is a game of pure speed, observation, and auditory focus.
Originating as a parlor game variant of Snap in the late Victorian era, Animals became a popular children's party game due to its noisy and interactive nature.
3-6 players. Each player MUST choose a distinct animal (e.g., Cat, Dog, Cow, Rooster) and tell the others.
The entire deck is dealt out face down to the players as evenly as possible. Players keep their cards in a face-down pile and do not look at them.

items.text: The Farmyard Snap: Instead of ranks, use a specialized deck where the animals are printed on the cards. You match the animal on the card to the sound you must make.
